authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3906 khura explicitly gives Bshk khur and Torwali khū foot, while section 2 *khuḍa contains retroflex khuṛ. Exact parent selection respects the survey rhotic distinction. Reviewed comparison: Kal kʰūr “leg” (f_722dftnrlogju). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12583 śṛṅga explicitly gives Bshk ṣīṅ, northern ṣiṅga and Hindi sī̃g horn. These singular/plural variants match the horn family with final nasal and glottal details preserved. Reviewed comparison: Tor ṣīŋ “horn” (f_sigr23n7qdthg). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
